description: Format a DKIM public key as the TXT record to publish at selector._domainkey.yourdomain. Returns the DNS host and the TXT value to paste, plus any warnings. It does not change DNS.

keyType.description: Key type: rsa (default, what most providers use) or ed25519.

publicKey.description: The DKIM public key your email provider shows in its DKIM settings. Paste it as given, with or without the BEGIN/END PUBLIC KEY lines.

selector.description: The DKIM selector your email provider gave you, e.g. google or s1. The record goes at <selector>._domainkey.<domain>.

name: generate_dkim_record

host.description: Where to publish it: the DNS name (host) of the TXT record.

toolUrl.description: The same check as a free web tool on pipefire.ai.

value.description: The record value to paste into DNS.

warnings.description: Things to check before publishing, such as nearing the SPF 10-lookup limit. Empty when there are none.

title: DKIM record generator
